mutants.description: Mutant 1: Omits denominator division (1 - phi) when inverting AR(1) smoothing.
Mutant 2: Adds lagged returns instead of subtracting when inverting AR(1) filter.
Mutant 3: Uses linear annualization factor 4.0 instead of sqrt(4) = 2.0 for quarterly volatility.
Mutant 4: Inverts regression slope denominator, computing Cov(R_a, R_m) / Var(R_a) instead of Var(R_m).
Mutant 5: Zeroes the initial period return R_0^true instead of preserving observed initial return.
